_about: tools/bench.py's budgets, by system: the most each number may be before CI fails. Set from GitHub's runners (macOS and Windows: run 44569611440; Linux: run 44600968881, 2026-11-19): times about twice what they measured, sizes and memory about a third more, since runners vary; idle_redraws and incremental_differs are correctness, with no headroom. A system with no entry only records its numbers. Lower a budget when the code gets faster; raise one only with the reason in the commit. macOS and Windows build_s, headless_mb and desktop_mb raised 2026-11-21 for ceesafec 0.84.1, whose builds on those runners are twice the size and time (run 44886852410: macOS 37 to 57 s, 1.78 and 1.93 MB; Windows 29 to 39 s, 2.24 and 2.43 MB), with the same rule; the cause is open (CEESAFE-FINDINGS.md Q4).
